objective: Maximize realizable strategic acquisition value and the probability of a competitive process by increasing validated economics, buyer-specific synergy, defensibility and transferability while reducing buyer risk discounts.

buyerClasses.class: Dining networks / restaurant reservation and engagement platforms
adjacencyExamples: American Express dining ecosystem / Resy / Tock / proposed TheFork
buyerClasses.purchaseMotive: Acquire verified restaurant supply, consumer dining intent, merchant relationships and a repeatable regional discovery layer.

buyerClasses.class: Local commerce / delivery / merchant demand platforms
buyerClasses.purchaseMotive: Add verified local merchant density and high-intent discovery that can improve merchant demand generation, offers, sponsored placement or commerce conversion.
Extend post-booking traveler engagement into structured local food, activities, events and real-time decision support.
Acquire a local intent layer combining what-to-do-now, events, activities and nearby food with attributable action handoffs.
Add external demand generation, local discovery and verified public business data to an existing merchant operating relationship.
Acquire a reusable regional operating system whose merchant, location, trust and consumer layers can support Gastro, Lifestyle, Works and future verticals.
Acquire structured, fresh, first-party-confirmed and field-level rights-governed local data plus verification/change history.

buyerClasses.class: Financial buyers / SaaS or marketplace consolidators
buyerClasses.purchaseMotive: Acquire predictable recurring cashflow, transferable operations and a repeatable expansion engine.

evidenceLadder.name: Acquisition Clean
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: G1 P0 risks controlled; prevents discount but does not itself create buyer pull.

evidenceLadder.name: Paid Business Proof
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: Auditable paid merchant demand via contract/invoice/payment or equivalent.

evidenceLadder.name: Consumer Demand Proof
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: Real usage, repeat behavior and high-intent actions; vanity traffic excluded.

evidenceLadder.name: Merchant Outcome Proof
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: Attributed useful merchant outcome such as qualified lead, reservation handoff, call, directions, offer redemption or agreed equivalent.

evidenceLadder.name: Data / Supply Defensibility
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: First-party confirmation, freshness operations and buyer-safe rights segregation.

evidenceLadder.name: Regional Repeatability
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: Second region uses same product/operating playbook without bespoke core rebuilding.

evidenceLadder.name: Founder Independence
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: Non-founder operator can run region/onboarding/QA/issues with bounded founder involvement.

evidenceLadder.name: Quantified Buyer Synergy
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: At least three buyer classes modeled using real HOY data and an explicit value mechanism.

evidenceLadder.name: Competitive Buyer Process
evidenceLadder.requiredEvidence: After freeze release: several qualified buyers engaged in parallel; one conversation is not competition.

FAST_STRATEGIC_OPTION.purpose: Create an early credible option to sell well without prematurely surrendering upside.

COMPETITIVE_VALUE_BUILD.purpose: Build bargaining power and the probability of multiple credible buyers.

immediateBacklog.action: Close or externally decide G1 deal killers
Define one auditable paid Gastro founding offer
Instrument buyer-value metrics: high-intent actions, merchant attribution, repeat usage and freshness
Quantify top-three buyer synergy models only after real G2 data exists
Maintain evidence-based buyer universe; activate names only with current strategic fit

marketEvidence.fact: American Express announced a proposed $700m cash acquisition of TheFork; TheFork connects millions of diners with more than 50,000 restaurants in 11 European countries.
marketEvidence.use: Dining-network strategic-value precedent only; not a HOY valuation comparable or buyer-interest signal.
